source_snapshot.procedure: Fully populate and run Reboot 100 times.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors, hang or lost device.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; interprets cold reboot as full power off/on.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; proposes owner-defined cold-state/fixture semantics.

old_problem: The title requires cold reboot, while the only operative instruction is generic Reboot; neither the source nor an approved project spec states which host/chassis/DC/AC/BMC rails must turn off.
disposition_reason: ED-06 forbids treating warm, cold, AC and DC cycles as interchangeable. Unlike a runtime IP or dwell value, the missing power-state boundary defines the core stimulus; parameterizing a guessed full-power sequence would manufacture coverage not authorized by the source.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row63 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3096 and actual next row64/history3097 were read.
The procedure says only Reboot and provides no S5, BMC chassis command, DC rail, AC removal, discharge or auxiliary/BMC-state definition.
DeepSeek's full-power interpretation and GPT V2's suggested definition are not an approved project authority.
Until the exact state boundary is supplied, 100 warm resets could be mislabeled cold coverage; no action ran.

test_case.test_name: One hundred cold reboots at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: After an authoritative cold-state definition exists, verify full inventory recovers through 100 such transitions under cold/low-rail margin.
required_package: Full inventory and per-cycle readiness oracle
test_case.test_command: DO NOT RUN. Obtain the project-approved cold reboot transition first; then implement exactly that 100-cycle sequence with per-cycle measured states, readiness, inventory and events.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until the authoritative transition identifies which rails/controllers lose power and what proves the required cold state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is permitted from generic `reboot`, inferred full-power cycling or final boot health. Every cycle must match the approved cold-state boundary and oracle.
safety_gate: No power actuation until cold semantics and fixture are approved
Rated interlocked equipment and OOB observation
Preserve logs; abort on electrical/moisture/boot/device fault
test_case.recovery: Recovery cannot be safely finalized until the power boundary and BMC/auxiliary state are defined; the approved spec must include abort isolation, nominal restoration and failed-cycle handling.

source_conflict.reason: Title says cold reboot but procedure's generic Reboot does not establish a cold rather than warm/power-cycle path.

blocked.reason: Core stimulus and recovery boundary are indeterminate and cannot be guessed under ED-06.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Provide authoritative cold-state semantics, actuator/fixture, true-off proof, readiness oracle and recovery.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the exact host/chassis/DC/AC/BMC state transition and recovery contract.

project_authority: Only the platform project specification can define the intended cold reboot boundary.
